fusions.name: Capillary Snare
fusions.desc: Casts ten thousand fine root hairs over one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, more the further they reach, up to 1.4 times, with a 60% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tangled Filaments
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh of filaments over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, stripping 6% armour for 3 seconds and slowing each by 15%.

fusions.name: Bast Wrapping
fusions.desc: Binds you in strips of bark fibre, raising your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Felted Root Mat
fusions.desc: When you take damage from anything but fire, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
